name: NFC
plain: Lets the app read or emulate NFC tags and cards.
meaning: Reads tags, payment-style cards and badges. Android grants it at install; iOS uses a capability and purpose string.

ios.store_policy: App Review 5.1.1; some uses need Apple entitlements
ios.api_surface: Core NFC, NFC and SE entitlement
ios.note: Reader mode on iPhone 7 and later; background tag reading iOS 12; third-party card emulation is regionally limited.

limits.headline: Can scan NFC tags and cards that you hold to the phone
limits.user_action: You tap Scan tag and hold the phone near an NFC tag or card
can: Scan tags, badges and similar cards
Scan tags in the background on iPhone (iOS 12 and later)
Act as a contactless card on Android
cannot: Scan on iPhone without the system scan sheet for standard scanning
Act as a card on iPhone in most regions
Work on iPhone 6 and older; scanning starts with iPhone 7
limits.differs: Android grants NFC at install with no prompt; iPhone shows a system scan sheet and limits card emulation by region.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app read tags and cards you tap on the phone, and sometimes act as a card.

marketing.name: Core NFC
marketing.pitch: Read NFC tags in your app, including in the background, for fast tap based experiences.

marketing.name: NFC on Android
marketing.pitch: Use NFC to read tags and talk to cards from your app.

story.for_you: You hold the phone near a tag on a poster, a smart card, a door or a product. The phone buzzes and the app opens. It usually needs no prompt on Android and a system sheet on iPhone.
story.for_makers: A tap is the fastest way to start a task, such as paying, checking in or pairing. Makers use tags for marketing, access control and proof that an item is genuine. A tag can start an app with a link.

use_cases.example: You tap a card against a phone to pay a small seller.
You tap a transit pass or hotel key at a gate.
A toy figure or card tapped on the phone unlocks a character.
You tap a tag on a poster to open a coupon or product page.
A medical alert tag lets a first responder see your allergies.
A tag by the door turns on a night scene.
A passport or ID card is read to prove who you are.

story.android_note: Android grants NFC at install and has supported emulating a card since Android 4.4.
story.ios_note: Reader mode works on iPhone 7 and later, and background tag reading works since iOS 12. Third party card emulation is limited by region.

technical_bounds: iOS uses a system scan sheet
iOS shows a system scan sheet; Android reads silently while the app is on screen
Android 10+ blocks reading from the background
Needs touch distance of a few centimeters

linkedin.how: LinkedIn passport verification, run with Persona, needs the LinkedIn mobile app, the phone's NFC scanner and the camera for the photo page and a live selfie. Persona deletes face geometry right after processing and keeps ID and selfie for up to 30 days (third-party write-ups).
